subject: MBTA Vegetation Management and South Street Compliance
overview: The Commission approved a five-year vegetation management plan for the MBTA commuter rail right-of-way and reviewed updates on several upcoming riverfront projects. Members also discussed a pending planting compliance matter at 54 South Street, scheduling a site visit to verify the status of installed trees and shrubs.

items.title: MBTA Right-of-Way Vegetation Management
items.summary: Approved a Request for Determination of Applicability (RDA) for a five-year vegetation management plan along the commuter rail right-of-way, issuing a positive 2A determination for resource boundaries and a negative determination for the proposed maintenance work.

items.title: Conservation Agent Updates
items.summary: Received informational updates regarding upcoming notices of intent for expansion projects on Arlington Street, DCR road safety improvements at the High Street Rotary, and the design status of a proposed COVID-19 memorial garden at Clippership Park.

items.title: 54 South Street Planting Discussion
items.summary: Discussed the status of completed plantings at 54 South Street; the matter was continued to the next meeting to allow the agent to conduct a site inspection and verify the quantity and density of the installed vegetation.
